title: Mini Sweet Potato Pies
description: Hand pies of spiced sweet potato filling sealed between cinnamon-sugar rounds of pie crust, baked golden and dusted with powdered sugar.

steps.heading: Filling
steps.text: In a large mixing bowl, combine the sweet potatoes, butter, eggs, vanilla, spices, salt and both sugars, and mix well.

steps.heading: Cut the Rounds
steps.text: Flatten the dough and cut out circles using a bowl or cup. Re-roll the scraps and repeat until all the dough is used.

steps.heading: Assemble
steps.text: Butter the dough circles and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Spoon filling onto half of the circles, lay the remaining circles on top (cinnamon-sugar side down), and press the edges firmly with a fork.

steps.heading: Bake
steps.text: Set the pies on a baking sheet, brush the tops with egg wash and bake for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
